termsSummary: Gutenberg: the website is for humans only. Bulk or automated downloads must come from a mirror, and machine use should go through the offline catalogue files. So the books were found in pg_catalog.csv and fetched from gutenberg.pglaf.org, 2.5 s apart, and links point to the /ebooks/<n> landing pages. CCEL: robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 10 (obeyed at 10.5 s), and its works may be used for personal, educational or non-profit purposes. Nothing was taken from CCEL because it holds no Moody sermons. All texts are US public domain; use is limited to private, noncommercial reading. Full quotations are in TERMS.md.

For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her. And Jesus said, ‘Let her alone; why trouble ye her?
